pages.title: Gene Circuit Loom
pages.text: A bench where promoters and genes are wired into circuits and read out by the glow of a reporter.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the two promoter strengths and the cooperativity n. A toggle switch is bistable, and holds its state, only when n > 1 and the strengths are balanced; the stability must reach the recipe's level. At n = 1 it has one state and cannot latch.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Gene Circuit, Living Catalyst.
